mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear at Badger Prairie County Park with a first quarter moon. The ISS will be visible tonight starting at 6:34 PM, rising in the west-northwest over Cross Plains and heading toward the northeast over Madison.

The Military Ridge State Trail is undergoing a major upgrade. The city is paving the trail and replacing bridges to ensure year-round access for cyclists and pedestrians, with a public meeting scheduled for December 8 at the Verona Senior Center.

We have plenty to do around town starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow is a busy night with trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's and pizza specials at Lake Lou-ee.
In a notable incident from October 23, two thirteen-year-olds were stopped for riding prohibited e-motos, leading to citations for their parents.
Today's flavor of the day is the rich Chocolate Volcano. The store is currently open and will be serving guests until 10:00 PM tonight.
